science.qualification: Photosphere color from the star's ground-based spectrophotometry (Pulkovo catalogue). 75 (Moravveji et al. 2012, ApJ 747, 108) no model table used here reaches it; Claret & Bloemen (2011)'s ATLAS models start at log g 2.5 at that temperature. The disc is unresolved: no map or absolute brightness is implied. Self-luminous, so no lighting. The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Howarth (2011), MNRAS 413, 1515 computes from ATLAS9 model atmospheres for the Bessell V band at 12,100 K and log g 1.91, read between the models t12000g15, t12000g20, t12250g15, t12250g20 (u1 0.233, u2 0.330): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
